request: With Nd3 and a seven-diagonal bishop, reject support only when White is below the bishop AND Black is above the bishop in rank; D4 equivalents apply.

method.kind: Incremental maintained graph update, not a fresh enumeration
method.coverage: The previous rank-only rejection removed 477 roots. Re-evaluated that complete set; 337 are restored. The new guard is a strict relaxation, so no other root can change. Refreshed every potential White predecessor of restored roots; prior executable fingerprint reproduced.
